description: How the controller decided on Unstep's proposals, per day over the last 30 days: how many were approved, how many rejected, and the share rejected. Real traffic only. Use it to see whether a rule is being overridden more or less over time.

configuration.query: FROM unstep-events | WHERE decision IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 days | EVAL day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp) | STATS approved = SUM(CASE(decision == "approve", 1, 0)), rejected = SUM(CASE(decision == "reject", 1, 0)) BY day | EVAL rejected_share = ROUND(rejected * 1.0 / (approved + rejected), 3) | SORT day ASC
